entities.name: T3412 extended value
entities.description: An information element that the UE may include to request a particular T3412 value when the T3324 value IE is also included.

entities.name: T3324 value
entities.description: An information element whose presence conditions the inclusion of the T3412 extended value IE.

entities.name: T3324 value IE is included
entities.description: Condition that the T3324 value IE is included, which enables the UE to include the T3412 extended value IE.

relations.description: The inclusion of the T3412 extended value IE is guarded by the condition that the T3324 value IE is included.
The condition is established by the presence of the T3324 value IE.
